crossRefs.note: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.
A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam…
“I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he…
For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and…
“Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because…
“Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together…
Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their…
PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.”
For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

people.name: Media
people.line: An ancient kingdom; part of the Persian Empire

translations.web: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
translations.bsb: Behold, I will stir up against them the Medes, who have no regard for silver and no desire for gold.
translations.kjv: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight
